info.title: Longevity Health Analytics Platform API
info.description: Longevity Health Analytics Platform API. Documentation-support software — not an autonomous medical decision-maker. Synthetic data only in development and tests.

schema.title: Response My Tenants Api V1 Tenancy My Tenants Get

post.description:
Probe THIS tenant for likely-duplicate patients before creating one.

Read-only and tenant-scoped (explicit filter + RLS): an identical patient in another
tenant is invisible by construction. Audited with the candidate COUNT only — the
audit service's forbidden-key guard rejects names outright.

schema.title: Response List Patients Api V1 Patients Get

post.description:
Create a synthetic patient; optionally record onboarding consents atomically.

Duplicate guard: a STRONG candidate (same external_ref, or same normalized name +
date of birth in this tenant) rejects the create with 409 `duplicate_patient` unless
the client passes `allow_duplicate=true` after showing the candidates to the user —
a duplicate can be created deliberately, never silently. Weak (name-only) matches
never block. The 409 rolls the transaction back; nothing persists for a rejected
attempt.

post.description:
Irreversibly erase the patient of an APPROVED request (gated tombstone).

The DB work (anonymize the patient, hard-delete PII artifacts, withdraw consents, redact
the append-only interpretation free text) runs in this request's single transaction. We
commit it, then purge object storage AFTER commit — an S3 delete is not transactional, so
it must not run before the DB is durable, and it is idempotent/re-runnable if it fails.
Generate and download the patient's data package (a ZIP; see docs/product/DATA_EXPORT.md).

ActionabilityClass.title: ActionabilityClass
ActionabilityClass.description: Engine 2 — Actionability class (closed, DISJOINT from CIS, one per domain axis).

AdequacyStatus.title: AdequacyStatus
AdequacyStatus.description: Adequacy is a closed enum, NEVER a number (a numeric confidence is a forbidden score).

CisStatus.title: CisStatus
CisStatus.description: Engine 1 — Credible Improvement Status (closed, one per domain axis).

ConsentGrantIn.title: ConsentGrantIn
ConsentGrantIn.description:
A consent granted at onboarding, recorded by the creating staff member.

Purposes are the existing CLOSED vocabulary (synthetic-Alpha placeholders pending the
DPO/counsel taxonomy) — onboarding never invents one.

ConsentPurpose.title: ConsentPurpose
ConsentPurpose.description:
Purpose a consent event scopes — a CLOSED vocabulary.

These are SYNTHETIC-ALPHA PLACEHOLDER values. The real, lawful purpose taxonomy and the
per-purpose Art. 9(2) lawful basis are a DPO/counsel deliverable (PENDING), NOT an engineering
default — see docs/regulatory (Regulatory-Lead UNASSIGNED). Only `report_release` is enforced as
a gate today (on patient-facing report release); the others name transitions for completeness.

CoverageOut.title: CoverageOut
CoverageOut.description:
Tenant-wide observation coverage counts for the dashboard "Datenlage" tile (ADR-0006).

Plain counts + freshness over real observations — NOT a clinical data-quality score. The
quality/rules model that the comp's "94 %" gauge implied does not exist (Gate G1); these are
the honest coverage figures the UI renders instead of a fabricated percentage.

DataExportOut.title: DataExportOut
DataExportOut.description: One generated export, as its audit event recorded it (no content is kept).

DeletionReasonCategory.title: DeletionReasonCategory
DeletionReasonCategory.description:
Why an erasure is requested — a CLOSED vocabulary, never free text.

SYNTHETIC-ALPHA PLACEHOLDER values (like ConsentPurpose): the real, counsel-authored
erasure-basis taxonomy — and the balance against clinical retention duties (e.g.
§ 630f BGB / Art. 17(3) exemptions) — is a pending DPO/counsel deliverable. A closed
enum (not free text) so the request itself can never carry PII.

DocumentImportSummary.title: DocumentImportSummary
DocumentImportSummary.description: What the one import of a stored document did (as it was imported).

DomainAxis.title: DomainAxis
DomainAxis.description: The six founder-approved longevity body-system axes (closed; ADR-0003).

DuplicateMatchBasis.title: DuplicateMatchBasis
DuplicateMatchBasis.description:
How an existing patient matched a pre-create duplicate probe — a CLOSED vocabulary.

Response-only (never stored in a column, so no CHECK-constraint migration). The matching
heuristic is deliberately conservative and documented (docs/notes/0011): exact matches on
normalized fields only, never fuzzy similarity — an over-eager matcher would train staff
to click through the warning.

HeldValueOut.title: HeldValueOut
HeldValueOut.description: A value the patient already holds, as source representation.

ReportRejectionReason.title: ReportRejectionReason
ReportRejectionReason.description:
Why a report version was rejected — a CLOSED vocabulary.

Never free text: the reason is stored on the version and written to the audit trail, and
neither may carry patient data. Whoever reworks the report reads it to know what to change.

PROPOSED values (engineering proposal, 2026-10-12) awaiting the medical director's
confirmation — see docs/regulatory/CLASSIFICATION_REGISTER.md. Changing the set is a
migration (the DB CHECK lists the values).

ReviewDecision.title: ReviewDecision
ReviewDecision.description:
Closed decision vocabulary for resolving a review item (API layer).

A human either PUBLISHes the observation (it becomes clinical-workflow-visible)
or REJECTs it (it never publishes). There is no third outcome.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: Tenant staff roles. Patients are not staff and have no Membership.

ThroughputOut.title: ThroughputOut
ThroughputOut.description:
Real per-day report-version throughput for the dashboard "Review-Durchsatz" chart.

`created` = versions created that day; `signed` = versions approved (signed off) that day —
both from persisted `ReportVersion` timestamps, tenant-scoped. A real rate over time, NOT a
fabricated trend; zero-activity days are included so the series has no gaps.

TriStateAxis.title: TriStateAxis
TriStateAxis.description: Verdict-free supporting-evidence axes (three cells per domain verdict).
